tools.name: DISA STIG Viewer
tools.license: U.S. Government distribution; package terms apply
tools.purpose: Create, edit, validate, import, and export DISA STIG checklists.
access_requirements: Download from the official DoD Cyber Exchange tool page.
tools.provenance_note: Official DISA tool; the user guide documents CSV round trips and CKLB import into eMASS.
limitations: Control Atlas interoperability claims require testing against a named STIG Viewer release.

tools.name: Evaluate-STIG
tools.purpose: Automate selected DISA STIG evaluations and produce checklist results.
supported_outputs: STIG checklist results; exact current formats require authorized-source verification
access_requirements: Current package and documentation may require CAC or authorized DoD community access.
tools.provenance_note: Control Atlas can catalog the official access path but cannot inspect or redistribute CAC-gated assets.
limitations: No public source repository was verified.
Do not infer schemas or license terms from third-party copies.

tools.name: MITRE eMASS Client
tools.license: Apache-2.0 with MITRE redistribution and notice terms
tools.purpose: Provide generated Ruby and TypeScript clients and models for the eMASS REST API.
access_requirements: An eMASS instance, API access, and required credentials or certificates are needed for live operations.
tools.provenance_note: MITRE states the client is based on an OpenAPI representation of the official eMASS API specification.
limitations: The public client is not an official eMASS import template.
API 3.22 can differ from a target instance.

tools.name: eMASSer
tools.purpose: Automate eMASS business workflows through the eMASS REST API.
access_requirements: An eMASS instance, API access, and required credentials or certificates are needed.
tools.provenance_note: Uses MITRE's generated eMASS client and adds input, transformation, routing, and workflow behavior.
limitations: It demonstrates API automation, not generic Excel import compatibility.

tools.name: MITRE Security Automation Framework CLI
tools.purpose: Convert, validate, summarize, and transport security assessment data using Heimdall Data Format and related formats.
access_requirements: Local CLI installation or container runtime, depending on deployment.
tools.provenance_note: Maintained MITRE open-source implementation with converters and fixtures useful for interoperability testing.
limitations: Supported converters must be checked by release; conversion does not establish agency acceptance.

tools.name: MITRE Heimdall
tools.purpose: Visualize, normalize, and compare security assessment results using Heimdall Data Format.
access_requirements: Hosted or locally deployed web application.
tools.provenance_note: MITRE open-source reference implementation for the normalized HDF result model.
limitations: A visualization or normalized result is not an authorization decision.

tools.name: STIG Manager Client Modules
tools.purpose: Provide JavaScript modules for clients of the STIG Manager API and STIG data workflows.
access_requirements: A compatible STIG Manager API is required for live client operations.
tools.provenance_note: Public client modules from the same GitHub organization as STIG Manager.
limitations: API behavior and module versions must match the deployed STIG Manager release.

tools.name: Vulnerator
tools.purpose: Consolidate vulnerability and STIG data and generate historical eMASS or POA&M-oriented workbook outputs.
access_requirements: Windows desktop prerequisites described by the project.
tools.provenance_note: Useful as an MIT-licensed historical field and layout reference, not as a current eMASS contract.
limitations: Maintenance is stale relative to current eMASS and FedRAMP formats.
Current import compatibility must be independently tested.

tools.name: OpenSCAP
tools.purpose: Evaluate SCAP security content and produce standards-based configuration and vulnerability assessment results.
access_requirements: Supported operating system and local scanner installation.
tools.provenance_note: Maintained open-source SCAP implementation; interoperability depends on supported SCAP specifications.
limitations: Not every DISA manual check can be automated by SCAP content.

tools.name: Microsoft PowerSTIG
tools.purpose: Apply and audit supported DISA STIG settings through PowerShell Desired State Configuration.
access_requirements: PowerShell DSC and a supported Windows or Microsoft product target.
tools.provenance_note: Maintained Microsoft open-source implementation for a defined subset of DISA STIG technologies.
limitations: Coverage is product-specific and does not replace manual review of non-automated checks.

tools.name: ComplianceAsCode Content
tools.purpose: Develop machine-readable security policy content and remediation for Linux and related platforms.
access_requirements: Build tooling or a packaged content release appropriate to the target platform.
tools.provenance_note: Maintained open-source security-content project with reusable profiles and tests.
limitations: Profile availability and automation coverage vary by product and release.
